stories.title: A city finished replacing its lead pipes a year early
stories.label: government
stories.summary: Every service line in the system has now been swapped out. The work wrapped up ahead of schedule and came in under the original budget.

stories.title: A town's library started lending tools, and never stopped
stories.label: people
stories.summary: One donated drill and a single shelf became several hundred items, all free to borrow. The longest waiting list is for the extension ladder.

stories.title: Sea turtle nests hit a record along a protected coastline
stories.label: environment
stories.summary: Volunteers counted more nests this season than in any year since the survey began. Two decades of quieter beachfront lighting are getting most of the credit, along with a stretch of cooler sand.
